page_title: BBC Learning English - English at Work / Lost in France
title: Lost in France
description:
Anna and Tom are in a bit of a predicament. Following a successful business meeting they've returned to the airport to discover their flight has been cancelled. What are they going to do next? Anna needs to brief Paul about the delay.
This episode focuses on what to say when you need to brief your manager about something important.
phrases: It's good news – I've closed the deal with and the contract is signed.
We need to proceed with the order as quickly as possible.
I'm committed to getting the order delivered on time… but I will need some help.

listening_challenge.question: What does Anna want to drink at the bar?

transcript.speaker: Narrator
transcript.text: Welcome back to English at Work, where Anna and Tom are in a bit of a predicament. Following a successful business meeting, they've returned to the airport to discover their flight has been cancelled. What are they going to do next?

transcript.speaker: Tom
transcript.text: Right, they've rebooked us on to the next flight, which is at 7 o'clock tomorrow morning.

transcript.speaker: Anna
transcript.text: Tomorrow morning?! What are we going to do until then?

transcript.speaker: Tom
transcript.text: It's OK Anna, calm down. I've sorted out a hotel… quite a nice one actually.

transcript.speaker: Anna
transcript.text: But what about our new contract? I've got to sort it out!

transcript.speaker: Tom
transcript.text: Anna, take a deep breath… it'll be ok. Let's go and get a drink and we'll work things out.

transcript.speaker: Narrator
transcript.text: Anna, maybe Tom's right for once. Go and enjoy some French hospitality. You've done really well today but perhaps you should keep your boss Paul in the picture.

transcript.speaker: Anna
transcript.text: In the picture? I didn't take any photos.

transcript.speaker: Narrator
transcript.text: No Anna! I mean keep him informed. It's always a good idea to keep the boss updated on what's going on – he is the boss after all.

transcript.speaker: Anna
transcript.text: OK. I will.

transcript.speaker: Tom
transcript.text: Yeah, this one looks quite cosy. I'll order us a beer shall I?

transcript.speaker: Anna
transcript.text: I'd prefer an orange juice please.

transcript.speaker: Tom
transcript.text: Oh really? OK then. Err, Garcon. Je m'appelle un beer et citron juice thing. Au revoir!

transcript.speaker: Anna
transcript.text: What?! No Tom! Pardon, Je voudrais une grande biere et du juice d'orange s'il vous plait.

transcript.speaker: Waiter
transcript.text: Oui Madame.

transcript.speaker: Tom
transcript.text: I think she likes you! Well, everyone likes you Anna. I like you because…

transcript.speaker: Anna
transcript.text: I like you too Tom but don't you think I should call Paul and update him on what's going on… keep him in the picture?

transcript.speaker: Tom
transcript.text: I dunno. Let's just enjoy this moment shall we? And besides, he'll be at his biscuit appreciation class by now.

transcript.speaker: Anna
transcript.text: No. I would be happier just to call him. Could I borrow your mobile phone please? My battery has run out.

transcript.speaker: Tom
transcript.text: Yeah sure. You'll find his number under Attila the Hun.

transcript.speaker: Anna
transcript.text: Attila the Hun?

transcript.speaker: Tom
transcript.text: Just my little joke!

transcript.speaker: Anna
transcript.text: Cheeky! But hold on… what am I going to say to him?

transcript.speaker: Narrator
transcript.text: Well, don't call him Attila the Hun! Think before you call him: It's good news – you've closed the deal and the contract is signed. We need to proceed with the order as quickly as possible. And say, I'm committed to getting the order delivered on time. But if you need help, ask for it.

transcript.speaker: Anna
transcript.text: OK I will. It's ringing…

transcript.speaker: Paul
transcript.text: Hello?

transcript.speaker: Anna
transcript.text: Hi Paul. It's Anna. I've got some good news!

transcript.speaker: Paul
transcript.text: Hold on. Sorry, I'm just munching some new crumbly cream biscuits. Now, what's the good news? Is it about the contract?

transcript.speaker: Anna
transcript.text: Yes! I've closed the deal with Fruit Traders International and the contract is signed.

transcript.speaker: Paul
transcript.text: Excellent news.

transcript.speaker: Anna
transcript.text: To keep them happy, we need to proceed with the order as quickly as possible.

transcript.speaker: Paul
transcript.text: Of course, of course. So what are you planning to do?

transcript.speaker: Anna
transcript.text: Well, obviously, I'm committed to getting the order delivered on time but I might need some help. I wonder if Tom could…

transcript.speaker: Paul
transcript.text: Yes, Tom can help you. Denise tells me you have a… special chemistry! Actually, where is Tom now? Is he home yet?

transcript.speaker: Anna
transcript.text: He's not. Actually Paul, Tom and I are going to stay in a hotel tonight… Hello? Hello? Oh, I've lost the signal, he's gone.

transcript.speaker: Tom
transcript.text: Never mind Anna. I think he got the message. Another drink?

transcript.speaker: Narrator
transcript.text: Let's hope Paul has got the right message about Anna and Tom! Anyway, she's briefed the boss and kept him in the picture. Here's a reminder of some of the phrases she used:

transcript.speaker: It's good news – I've closed the deal and the contract is signed.
transcript.text:
We need to proceed with the order as quickly as possible.
I'm committed to getting the order delivered on time… but I will need some help.

transcript.speaker: Narrator
transcript.text: A good day's work for Anna but now it's time for bed.

transcript.speaker: Tom
transcript.text: Right, well, it's time for bed. We've got an early start tomorrow.

transcript.speaker: Anna
transcript.text: So, where are we staying?

transcript.speaker: Tom
transcript.text: A lovely little boutique hotel, just round the corner. I've booked a room with a view.

transcript.speaker: Anna
transcript.text: A room? One room?!

transcript.speaker: Tom
transcript.text: Err yeah. That's all they had, actually… honest!

transcript.speaker: Narrator
transcript.text: Hmm. This could be interesting. Let's hope things remain professional.  Until next time. Bye!
